def get_ludic(n: int) -> list[int]:
    if n < 1:
        return []
    ludic = list(range(1, n + 1, 2))  # start with odd numbers only, 1 is included
    if ludic and ludic[0] == 1:
        # 1 is always ludic
        pass
    i = 1  # start from the second element (index 1) which is 3
    while i < len(ludic):
        step = ludic[i]
        if step > len(ludic):
            break
        # Remove every step-th element starting from index step-1
        del ludic[step - 1::step]
        i += 1
    return ludic
